description: This is a test class for the CredentialsObject class in the org.eclipse.hono.util package. It contains unit tests verifying the serialization/deserialization, secret validation, and integrity checks of credential objects used in the Hono project.

classes.name: CredentialsObjectTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CredentialsObject, verifying marshaling, secret validation, and exception handling

methods.name: testMarshaling
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization and deserialization of CredentialsObject, ensuring all properties are preserved

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsMissingSecrets
methods.description: Verifies that CredentialsObject correctly throws an exception when secrets are missing

methods.name: testCheckSecretsAcceptsEmptySecrets
methods.description: Ensures that empty secrets are considered valid in CredentialsObject

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsMalformedNotBefore
methods.description: Checks that malformed 'not before' timestamp results in an exception

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsMalformedNotAfter
methods.description: Checks that malformed 'not after' timestamp results in an exception

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsInconsistentValidityPeriod
methods.description: Verifies that inconsistent 'not before' and 'not after' timestamps trigger an exception

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsMissingHashFunction
methods.description: Ensures missing hash function in hashed password secrets results in an exception

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsMissingHashValue
methods.description: Ensures missing hash value in hashed password secrets results in an exception
